title: closed-loop-orchestrator-orion
goal: Create a closed-loop orchestrator for Orion: autopilot. Problem: all self-improvement mechanisms (lesson recording via recordLesson, error-routing via nextStep, skill repair via recordRepairAttempt, skill promotion) exist but are fragmented and require manual commands. There is no automatic loop: when a guard-rail fails, a human must manually run orion next, then decide, then orion run repair --auto. Goal: a single src/core/autopilot.ts that closes the loop into an autonomous pipeline with: 1. A clear decision algorithm: in each situation Orion explicitly chooses which function to use (next, repair, think, shield, pay-debt). 2. Bounded iteration: a hard cap on iterations per run plus a token budget so it never loops forever (reuse budget.ts / ORION_MAX_BUDGET_TOKENS). 3. Telemetry: every autopilot action is traced (action, reason, token cost) into telemetry.ts. 4. Success closes lessons (markRepairFixed for skill repair, dedupe) and records a success pattern; failure exhaustion reports honestly. 5. CLI entry: orion autopilot that runs the closed loop and prints a machine-readable plus human summary. 6. Wire it into orion new --pipeline: after a guard FAIL, autopilot takes over (bounded) instead of just returning an error. Key integration points to reuse (do NOT duplicate): - src/core/lessons.ts: recordLesson, listLessons, findLessons - src/core/repair.ts: recordRepairAttempt, markRepairFixed, canAttemptRepair - src/skills/next/handler.ts: nextStep (returns selfCorrection or loopDetected or budgetExceeded) - src/skills/shield/handler.ts: shield (guard report) - src/skills/think/handler.ts: think - src/skills/out/handler.ts: out - src/core/budget.ts: maxBudgetTokens, readSpendLedger - src/core/telemetry.ts: trace - Use Orion's own change workflow only; do not invoke other agent toolkits. Success criteria (tests): - autopilot with a failing change routes through selfCorrection, bounded by MAX_ITER - autopilot stops on loopDetected and reports exhaustion honestly (no infinite loop) - autopilot stops on budgetExceeded - autopilot on a clean change is a no-op (no extra calls) - autopilot closes repair attempts on success and records a success pattern
